proposal.reason: Main change is CI test orchestration: daily/source-sanity workflow logic now generates case inputs from JSON families, updates grouping/resource policy (including 8-node and cross-rack allocation), and adds end-of-run performance workbook generation/artifact handling. Most file churn (workflow YAML, xtest generators/reporting scripts/tests, and removal of legacy daily CSV inputs) directly supports open-source test execution behavior rather than PCCL runtime modules.
